story: A man wanted to fly in a balloon.
But there was no basket, so he held on to a rope!
He hung from the balloon all day, and nobody could land it!
notes: 30 s looping ink drawing, no cut (scene-cut peaks are tiny, frames identical). Two actors: the balloon carries, the man holds/hangs; both man phrases reuse live:2 (same man region). Story sentence 2 uses 'held on to a rope' (more natural than 'held a rope' in narrative).
